memory_candidates.content: Claude Code subagent definition files (.claude/agents/*.md) do NOT auto-resolve @path references in their body text at spawn time -- the subagent receives the raw markdown body verbatim as its system prompt with no import-expansion step. This is a distinct code path from CLAUDE.md/memory files, which DO support real, auto-resolving @path imports (max depth 4, approval dialog on first external import). Verified both empirically (a live subagent's own un-expanded @-reference bullets) and via the official code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents docs. Any 'shared @-imported include' design for agent contract text must use generated-copy-with-lint (this repo's own CLAUDE.md-from-merge-sources generation is the precedent) rather than assuming automatic injection.

The real, documented Claude Code subagent frontmatter fields for tool/MCP restriction are `tools:` (allowlist, comma-separated string) and `disallowedTools:` (denylist, camelCase) and `mcpServers:` (camelCase). `allowed-tools:` is NOT a subagent field -- it belongs to SKILL.md/slash-command frontmatter, a different artifact type -- so any agent file using `allowed-tools:` is silently running with full inherited tool access. `mcp-servers:` (hyphenated) is also invalid; the correct spelling is `mcpServers:`, and a hyphenated spelling silently no-ops the MCP server declaration. Confirmed via the live official docs table at code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents.
